Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 85. Category: form. Super Saiyan.

Transformation
The Saiyan’s hair appears to grow thicker than the
SSJ 1 form and lightning begins to arc around them
occasionally. Their aura is enough to levitate small
rocks.
Increase your Power by 2
You deal an additional 1d6 to damage
Increase your Movement Speed by 20
At the end of your turn, you lose 2 Stamina
